permissions.purpose: Receive the checkout, invoice, refund and dispute events that credit your partners.
Read completed Checkout Sessions and Payment Link purchases to match them to the partner link the buyer clicked.
Read a customer’s metadata to match their payments to the user your app identified.
Record new subscriptions for referred customers.
Record paid invoices for referred customers so partners earn commission on them, including the promo code used.
Read refunds and disputed charges so commissions on refunded revenue are reversed or flagged.
Flag commissions on disputed payments for your review.
Match promotion codes used at checkout to your partners’ codes.
Create each partner’s customer-discount promotion code in your account, and deactivate it when the code is retired.
Check that a new partner code doesn’t collide with one of your own coupons.
Create the coupon behind each partner’s customer discount.
